subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): generic outbound delivery-report seam; WhatsApp native auto-reply reports provider-accepted sends

question: Should OpenClaw accept openclaw/plugin-sdk/outbound-delivery-report as the public contract for channel self-delivered sends once proof and rebase are supplied?
rationale: The patch adds release-facing Plugin SDK surface and event idempotency semantics; automation can verify code shape, but maintainers must own the permanent public API contract.

options.title: Accept seam after proof
options.body: Require a branch refresh, redacted real WhatsApp/runtime proof, and explicit maintainer acceptance of this narrow generic SDK contract before merge.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and ask for a design pass if maintainers are not ready to own this public subpath or idempotency shape.

recommendation.title: Accept seam after proof
recommendation.body: Require a branch refresh, redacted real WhatsApp/runtime proof, and explicit maintainer acceptance of this narrow generic SDK contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the adjacent outbound hook contract PR and co-authored later sent-hook fixes, so he is the best available routing owner for the public API decision.
